subject: Invoice rollback approval and customer remedy plan
messages:
From: Tom Riley <tom.riley@nectarhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Nectar Billing <billing@nectarhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:14:00 +0100
Subject: Discrepancy on Invoice RWF-2026-07-001 — request for rollback

Hi Karthik,

We discovered an overbilling on our July invoice (RWF-2026-07-001). The line for "dense-embedding storage" was charged for 3.2M tokens instead of the 320k tokens in our usage export. That produced a ~10x discrepancy and a EUR 11,200 difference.

Attached is the invoice and our usage export for July. Can Redwood propose a remediation path (rollback/credit schedule) and confirm how you will reflect VAT on any adjustment? We're EU-registered and will need a corrected invoice with VAT line items for our accounting.

Requested next steps:
- Confirmation you received this and will investigate
- Proposed timeline for a rollback or credit note
- Any documents you need from us (VAT cert, accounting contact)

Thanks,
Tom Riley
Head of Finance, Nectar Health
[Attachment: invoice_202607.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: usage_export_2026-07.csv (CSV)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tom Riley <tom.riley@nectarhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Invoice RWF-2026-07-001 — request for rollback

Tom — thanks for flagging this and for the clear artifacts. I'm sorry for the disruption.

Initial read: this looks like a metering/ingest parser bug that inflated the storage token count. We will not push a charge to collections while we sort this.

Proposed customer remedy plan (draft):
1) Immediate: Redwood to issue a temporary hold on the invoice and mark it as under dispute so AR doesn't pursue collections.
2) Investigation (48 hours): engineering to validate token counts and reproduce the miscount.
3) Adjustment: If confirmed, Redwood issues a credit note reversing the erroneous line and reissues a corrected invoice with VAT shown as required.
4) Goodwill: offer a one-month service credit for the operational impact (optional, pending approval).

I've attached a short adjustment plan and timeline for our internal approvals. Laura — can you confirm the credit-note workflow and expected issuance date once engineering confirms? Monica — I looped you to coordinate CS notes and the goodwill credit approval.

Please attach a copy of Nectar's VAT registration certificate so we can populate the corrected invoice.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Accounts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_adjustment_plan.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Tom Riley <tom.riley@nectarhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 14:07:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Invoice RWF-2026-07-001 — request for rollback

Thanks Karthik — that plan looks reasonable and appreciated. Attached is our VAT registration certificate and a short note from our accounting team confirming the affected project codes.

We do have one timing preference: if the credit is issued, can it appear on a corrected invoice dated no later than 2026-08-31? Our fiscal month close is the 1st and earlier paperwork helps us avoid reconciliation friction.

Tom
[Attachment: vat_certificate_nectar.pdf (PDF)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Riley <tom.riley@nectarhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 17:22:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Discrepancy on Invoice RWF-2026-07-001 — request for rollback

Hi Tom — quick update from finance.

Engineering validated the ingest parser issue this morning and confirmed the storage token count was multiplied by 10 for that SKU. We've prepared a final credit note and a corrected invoice.

Action items completed:
- Credit note issued: credit_note_RWF-2026-07-001.pdf (attached).
- Corrected invoice reissued with VAT line items and the original invoice voided.
- AR placed the original invoice on hold; no collections activity will occur.

Timing: the corrected invoice and credit note are effective and dated 2026-08-29, which should meet your close date requirement. Expect PDFs attached for your records. If you need those sent to a specific AP mailbox (e.g., ap@nectarhealth.com), let us know and we'll forward.

Monica will follow up on the goodwill credit approval and operational notes.

Apologies again for the mistake — appreciate your patience and the VAT certificate.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit_note_RWF-2026-07-001.pdf (PDF)]
